title: refactor(context): Split config keys in code, not at runtime
body:
### What does this PR try to resolve?

This avoids
- problems with proper splitting
- reduces work (even if its minor)

This may address #15901 but haven't looked into how to test it. Unsure if it helped with environment variables.

This does not help with `cargo config get`: `ConfigKey::from_str` should be switched to using a TOML key parser.
